mn33:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn33:2.1: ekādasahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato gopālako abhabbo gogaṇaṃ pariharituṃ phātikattuṃ.
mn33:2.3: idha bhikkhave gopālako na rūpaññū hoti. na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti. na āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti. na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti. na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti. na titthaṃ jānāti. na pītaṃ jānāti. na vīthiṃ jānāti. na gocarakusalo hoti. anavasesadohī ca hoti. ye te usabhā gopitaro gopariṇāyakā te na atireka pūjāya pūjetā hoti.
mn33:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave ekādasahi aṅgehi samannāgato gopālako abhabbo gogaṇaṃ pariharituṃ phātikattuṃ.
mn33:3.1: evameva kho bhikkhave ekādasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjituṃ.
mn33:3.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu na rūpaññū hoti. na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti. na āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti. na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti. na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti. na titthaṃ jānāti. na pītaṃ jānāti. na vīthiṃ jānāti. na gocarakusalo hoti. anavasesadohī ca hoti. ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghapariṇāyakā te na atirekapūjāya pūjetā hoti. (1.)
mn33:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na rūpaññū hoti?
mn33:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu “yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ sabbaṃ rūpaṃ cattāri mahābhūtāni catunnañca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya rūpanti” yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
mn33:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na rūpaññū hoti. (2.)
mn33:5.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti?
mn33:5.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu “kammalakkhaṇo bālo, kammalakkhaṇo paṇḍito”ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
mn33:5.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti. (3.)
mn33:6.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti?
mn33:6.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu uppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ adhivāseti, nappajahati na vinodeti na byantīkaroti na anabhāvaṃ gameti. uppannaṃ byāpādavitakkaṃ …pe… uppannaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ …pe… uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme adhivāseti, nappajahati na vinodeti na byantīkaroti na anabhāvaṃ gameti.
mn33:6.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti. (4.)
mn33:7.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti?
mn33:7.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā nimittaggāhī hoti anubyañjanaggāhī,
mn33:7.3: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya na paṭipajjati, na rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye na saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
mn33:7.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya nimittaggāhī hoti anubyañjanaggāhī,
mn33:7.9: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya na paṭipajjati, na rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye na saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
mn33:7.10: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti. (5.)
mn33:8.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti?
mn33:8.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ na vitthārena paresaṃ desetā hoti.
mn33:8.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti. (6.)
mn33:9.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na titthaṃ jānāti?
mn33:9.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ye te bhikkhū bahussutā āgatāgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā, te kālena kālaṃ upasaṅkamitvā na paripucchati na paripañhati:
mn33:9.5: tassa te āyasmanto avivaṭañceva na vivaranti, anuttānīkatañca na uttānīkaronti, anekavihitesu ca kaṅkhāṭhānīyesu dhammesu kaṅkhaṃ na paṭivinodenti.
mn33:9.6: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na titthaṃ jānāti. (7.)
mn33:10.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na pītaṃ jānāti?
mn33:10.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye desiyamāne na labhati atthavedaṃ, na labhati dhammavedaṃ, na labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.
mn33:10.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na pītaṃ jānāti. (8.)
mn33:11.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na vīthiṃ jānāti?
mn33:11.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
mn33:11.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na vīthiṃ jānāti. (9.)
mn33:12.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na gocarakusalo hoti?
mn33:12.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cattāro satipaṭṭhāne yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
mn33:12.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na gocarakusalo hoti. (10.)
mn33:13.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ saddhā gahapatikā abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavārenti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārehi. tatra bhikkhu mattaṃ na jānāti paṭiggahaṇāya.
mn33:13.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu anavasesadohī hoti. (11.)
mn33:14.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghapariṇāyakā, te na atirekapūjāya pūjetā hoti?
mn33:14.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghapariṇāyakā, tesu na mettaṃ kāyakammaṃ paccupaṭṭhāpeti āvī ceva raho ca,
mn33:14.3: na mettaṃ vacīkammaṃ paccupaṭṭhāpeti āvī ceva raho ca,
mn33:14.4: na mettaṃ manokammaṃ paccupaṭṭhāpeti āvī ceva raho ca.
mn33:14.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghapariṇāyakā, te na atirekapūjāya pūjetā hoti.
mn33:14.6: imehi kho bhikkhave ekādasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjituṃ.
mn33:15.1: ekādasahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato gopālako bhabbo gogaṇaṃ pariharituṃ phātikattuṃ.
mn33:15.3: idha bhikkhave gopālako rūpaññū hoti, lakkhaṇakusalo hoti, āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti, vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti, dhūmaṃ kattā hoti, titthaṃ jānāti, pītaṃ jānāti, vīthiṃ jānāti, gocarakusalo hoti, sāvasesadohī ca hoti, ye te usabhā gopitaro gopariṇāyakā, te atirekapūjāya pūjetā hoti.
mn33:15.4: imehi kho bhikkhave ekādasahi aṅgehi samannāgato gopālako bhabbo gogaṇaṃ pariharituṃ phātikattuṃ.
mn33:16.1: evameva kho bhikkhave ekādasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhabbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjituṃ.
mn33:16.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu rūpaññū hoti, lakkhaṇakusalo hoti, āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti, vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti, dhūmaṃ kattā hoti, titthaṃ jānāti, pītaṃ jānāti, vīthiṃ jānāti, gocarakusalo hoti, sāvasesadohī ca hoti, ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghapariṇāyakā te atirekapūjāya pūjetā hoti.
